name: Molecular and Cellular Biology PhD Program
detailsNote: Official information available; the December 1 deadline is published without a year and is not confirmed for Fall 2027. The GRE is not listed as a requirement but is not stated either way, and funding for international students is not stated.
summary: PhD in molecular and cellular biology at Boston College in Chestnut Hill. First-year coursework and laboratory rotations lead to the choice of a thesis lab.

publishedDeadlines.label: Published PhD application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: The graduate admission page lists "Ph.D. - December 1" for Molecular and Cellular Biology, with no year. Not confirmed for Fall 2027; confirm with the department.

english.toefl: 100 (5.0 on the new scale) or higher
english.note: Required for international applicants. Scores are valid from exams taken at most two years before the program deadline and must be sent directly by the testing agency.

applicationFee.note: Applicants for whom the fee would be a serious financial hardship may request a waiver with official documentation; only the Graduate Admissions Office can grant it. The page does not say whether international applicants qualify, so confirm. Currency exchange rates and payment difficulties alone do not count as hardship.

documents: Transcripts (official transcripts are due after matriculation, by July 15)
requirements.note: The page lists no GRE requirement for the Molecular and Cellular Biology PhD but does not say GRE is not required.

funding.note: The program page lists a 12-month minimum annual stipend of $40,000 for the academic year (no year given), tuition remission, and medical insurance covered with a teaching or research assistantship. It does not say whether international students are covered.
